data_fields.name: minimum plan length (our beats)
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 ply on our turn, 2 plies on the opponent's turn

data_fields.name: plan expiry window
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (correspondence plans wait for days); we must add one

best_idea: Queue a short plan of our beats keyed on enemy beats: an enemy beat consumes the head of each matching line, a mismatch drops the plan, the plan is capped in length, and two plans that differ at a beat we decide cannot both be kept.
decision_why: The plan model is plain data and fits a duel's queued counter; chess parts, the parity-based collision rule (not strict alternation in a duel) and the silent drops do not transfer as written; the truncation defect is fixed in the sketch.
acceptance: A src/fight server test: a queued guard-then-riposte plan against a high attack consumes the guard on the enemy's high attack and fires the riposte in the next window; a different enemy attack drops the plan with a plan-broken event; a plan never exceeds the cap and never fires an action the duel state rejects.
